title: 第20章 炼气三层-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王建新把桌上那两条鱼剩下的部分快速吃完，连鱼头都没放过，嚼碎了咽下去。

    鱼肉一进肚，那股浓郁的灵气又在体内炸开了。他来不及收拾碗筷，赶忙盘膝坐下，闭上眼睛，开始运转功法。

    体内的灵气像开了锅的水一样翻腾。鱼肉里的灵气被迅速吸收，转化成他自己丹田里的真气，一波一波地往里灌。丹田里的灵气团越来越密实，越来越滚烫，像一颗被压缩到极致的小太阳。

    经脉里的灵气在疯狂运转。一个周天，两个周天，三个周天……

    每转一个周天，那道横亘在炼气二层和三层之间的瓶颈就松动一分。裂缝越来越大，从头发丝那么细变成了手指那么宽。灵气从裂缝里渗过去，一点一点地冲刷着那道关卡。

    王建新稳坐不动，心神沉入丹田，引导灵气一遍又一遍地冲击。不急不躁，不急不躁。

    时间不知过了多久。也许是几个小时，也许是一整天。空间里没有白天黑夜，他只能靠体内的灵气运转来感知时间的流逝。

    一直到所有的灵气全部吸收后，王建新睁开眼睛，长长地吐出一口浊气。

    那道裂缝还在，没有完全突破，但已经开了好大一个口子。他能感觉到，离真正的突破用不了多长时间了。再积累一阵子，或者再吃一条那样的鱼，就能水到渠成。

    “快了快了。”王建新站起来，活动了一下手脚。虽然还没突破，但体内的灵气比之前又厚实了几分，浑身轻快。

    接下来的一个月，王建新刻苦了许多。

    以前他修炼三天打鱼两天晒网，想起来了就练一会儿，不想练了就躺着。现在不一样了，有了盼头，练起来就有劲。每天雷打不动地盘腿坐在河边，运转功法，引导灵气在体内循环。少则两三个小时，多则大半天，从不间断。

    空间里的牧草已经长出来了，绿油油的一片，盖住了之前光秃秃的地面。小麦也出了苗，齐刷刷的，看着就喜人。五条狗长得更快，已经半大了，整天在空间里疯跑，撵羊追牛，闹得鸡飞狗跳。

    王建新不管它们，由着它们闹。他自己一门心思扑在修炼上。

    时间过得快，转眼到了一月初。

    这天，王建新像往常一样盘腿坐在河边。灵气在体内运转了几十个周天，丹田里的灵气团已经胀到了极限，像一个吹到极致的气球，随时都可能炸开。

    那道瓶颈上的裂缝已经大得不像话了，灵气从裂缝里涌过去，一波一波地冲击着最后的阻碍。

    王建新心神沉定，不慌不忙。他引导着丹田里所有的灵气，汇聚成一股洪流，朝着那道关卡猛地冲了过去——

    轰。

    脑子里一声闷响，像什么东西炸开了。

    灵气像决堤的洪水一样，从丹田涌出，沿着经脉冲过那道关卡，一路向上，冲过脊椎，冲过头顶，顺着前面落下来，回到丹田。一个大周天，畅通无阻。

    关卡破了。

    炼气三层。

    体内的灵气开始质变。原本气态的灵气慢慢浓缩，变得粘稠，像雾一样，在丹田里弥漫。经脉被进一步拓宽，比炼气二层的时候宽了一倍有余，灵气在里面运转，顺畅得不像话。

    身体也在发生变化。从里到外，从骨骼到肌肉，从内脏到皮肤，每一个细胞都在被灵气冲刷、重组、强化。那种感觉很难形容——不疼不痒，但能感觉到自己的身体在变得不一样，像一块生铁被反复锻打，杂质被清除，留下的是精纯的钢铁。

    王建新没有急着睁眼，而是继续运转功法，把新突破的经脉全部打通，把暴涨的力量稳住。灵气在体内转了不知道多少圈，终于慢慢平息下来，安安稳稳地盘在丹田里。

    他睁开眼睛。

    世界又变了。

    炼气二层的时候，他觉得自己的视力已经够好了。现在再看，炼气二层的视力跟这个没法比。空间里的每一片草叶，叶子上的每一根绒毛，绒毛上挂着的每一颗水珠，都清清楚楚，像用放大镜看的一样。远处的羊群，他能看清每一只羊的眼睛，看清瞳孔里的倒影。

    耳朵也更灵了。他能听见河水流动的声音，不是一片哗哗声，而是每一滴水碰撞、破裂、融合的声音。能听见五条狗在远处打闹的喘息声，听见羊群反刍时胃里的蠕动声。

    身体轻得像要飘起来。他站起来，轻轻一跳——比炼气二层的时候高出了一大截，落地的声音轻得像一片叶子。

    王建新闭上眼睛，放开神识。

    方圆十米。

    炼气二层的时候是五米，现在是十米，翻了一倍。十米范围内的一切，不用看不用听，清清楚楚地映在脑海里。地面下半米深的蚯蚓，空气里飘浮的每一粒微尘，——总之，一切尽在掌握。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Jianxin quickly ate the rest of the two fish on the table, even the fish heads, chewed them up and swallowed them.

As soon as the fish meat entered the belly, the rich spiritual energy exploded in the body again.He didn't have time to clear away the dishes, so he hurriedly sat down cross-legged, closed his eyes, and started to run the technique.

The spiritual energy in the body is churning like water in a boiling pot.The spiritual energy in the fish meat was quickly absorbed and transformed into the true energy in his own Dantian, which was poured in wave by wave.The spiritual energy in the Dantian became denser and hotter, like a small sun compressed to the extreme.

The spiritual energy in the meridians is running wildly.One Sunday, two Sundays, three Sundays...

With every turn of the sky, the bottleneck between the second and third levels of Qi Refining becomes looser.The crack grew bigger and bigger, from hair-thin to finger-width.Spiritual energy seeped through the cracks, washing over the level bit by bit.

Wang Jianxin sat still, his mind sinking into his Dantian, guiding his spiritual energy to impact over and over again.Don't be impatient, don't be impatient.

I don’t know how much time has passed.Maybe a few hours, maybe a whole day.There is no day or night in the space, and he can only rely on the movement of spiritual energy in his body to sense the passage of time.

After all the spiritual energy was absorbed, Wang Jianxin opened his eyes and let out a long breath.

The crack is still there, not completely broken through, but a big hole has been opened.He could feel that it wouldn't be long before a real breakthrough.If you accumulate it for a while, or eat another fish like that, it will be a matter of course.

"Come on, come on." Wang Jianxin stood up and moved his hands and feet.Although he hasn't broken through yet, the spiritual energy in his body is thicker than before, and his whole body feels light.

In the next month, Wang Jianxin worked a lot harder.

In the past, he practiced three days fishing and two days drying nets. When he remembered, he would practice for a while, and when he didn't want to practice, he would lie down.It’s different now. With hope, I feel more motivated when I practice.Every day, I sit cross-legged by the river without moving, running the exercises and guiding the spiritual energy to circulate in the body.It can take as little as two or three hours, or as much as half a day, without interruption.

The pastures in the space have grown up, and the lush green cover covers the previously bare ground.The wheat seedlings have also sprouted, and they are all blooming, which is gratifying to look at.The five dogs grew faster and were already half-grown. They ran around in the space all day long, chasing sheep and cattle, making a lot of noise.

Wang Jianxin ignored them and let them make trouble.He devoted himself entirely to cultivation.

Time flies so fast, and it’s early January in the blink of an eye.

On this day, Wang Jianxin was sitting cross-legged by the river as usual.The spiritual energy has been circulating in the body for dozens of days, and the spiritual energy in the Dantian has swelled to the limit, like a balloon that has been inflated to the extreme, and may explode at any time.

The crack on the bottleneck was already huge, and spiritual energy surged through the crack, hitting the final obstacle one after another.

Wang Jianxin was calm and unhurried.He guided all the spiritual energy in his Dantian and gathered it into a torrent, rushing towards the checkpoint——

Boom.

There was a muffled sound in my head, like something exploded.

Like a flood that breaks a bank, spiritual energy gushes out from the Dantian, passes through the checkpoint along the meridian pulse, goes all the way up, rushes through the spine, rushes over the top of the head, falls along the front, and returns to the Dantian.A great week, smooth flow.

The level is broken.

The third level of Qi refining.

The spiritual energy in the body began to change qualitatively.The originally gaseous spiritual energy slowly condensed and became thick, like mist, filling the Dantian.The meridians have been further widened, more than twice as wide as when they were on the second level of Qi Refining, and the spiritual energy is flowing inside, incredibly smooth.

The body is also changing.From the inside to the outside, from bones to muscles, from internal organs to skin, every cell is being washed, reorganized and strengthened by spiritual energy.It's hard to describe the feeling - no pain or itching, but you can feel that your body is becoming different, like a piece of pig iron that has been repeatedly forged, the impurities are removed, and what is left is pure steel.

Wang Jianxin did not open his eyes in a hurry, but continued to operate the exercises to open up all the newly broken meridians and stabilize the skyrocketing power.The spiritual energy circulated in the body for an unknown number of times, and finally slowly calmed down, settling firmly in the Dantian.

He opened his eyes.

The world has changed again.

When he reached the second level of Qi Refining, he felt that his eyesight was good enough.Looking at it now, the eyesight at the second level of Qi Refining is incomparable to this.Every blade of grass in the space, every velvet on the leaves, and every drop of water hanging on the velvet are all clear, like looking through a magnifying glass.Among the sheep in the distance, he could clearly see the eyes of each sheep and the reflection in their pupils.

My ears are also sharper.He could hear the sound of the river flowing, not just a rush, but the sound of each drop of water colliding, breaking, and merging.You can hear the panting of five dogs fighting in the distance, and the squirming sounds of the sheep's stomachs as they regurgitate their cud.

The body is so light that it feels like it is floating.He stood up and jumped slightly - a lot higher than when he was on the second level of Qi Refining, and the sound of falling to the ground was as light as a leaf.

Wang Jianxin closed his eyes and let go of his consciousness.

A radius of ten meters.

When I was on the second level of Qi Refining, it was five meters, now it’s ten meters, doubled.Everything within ten meters is clearly reflected in my mind without seeing or hearing.Earthworms half a meter below the ground, every particle of dust floating in the air - in short, everything is under control.
